survey: Round wall clock seen straight on. A thick, glossy orange ring frames a flat off-white face and casts a soft shadow on the green striped wall behind it, so it reads as hanging flush on the wall. The face has 12 navy hour bars at even spacing and a ring of small navy minute dots around the edge, about four between each pair of bars. Three hands share one centre pivot, a navy hub capped with a red dot: a short, thick hour hand pointing just past 10, a longer minute hand pointing at 2 and ending at the 2 o'clock bar, and a thin red second hand reaching toward the 5 o'clock bar with a short tail behind the pivot. The time reads 10:10, and the hour hand sits slightly past 10 as it should. The ring is evenly round, and the hands are layered in a believable stacking order on the pivot.
